verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an API-driven KYC path where you capture KYC data in your own screens and submit it via the Customer API. It also documents a self-driving challenge frame that runs required verification steps before a buy completes, and a hosted flow where MoonPay runs KYC. However, the evidence covers consumer on/off-ramp KYC only, with nothing on business onboarding or on clearing third-party recipients. Missing for 10: documented KYB endpoints, recipient/counterparty onboarding before payouts, endpoint-level detail of the Customer API (verification status, approval states), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
